long_biography.plain_text:
A British private company was incorporated in June 2023 with Hamza Gulseven as its first controlling shareholder. His control ended the following May, when another individual became the controller. Gulseven returned in September as both director and holder of at least 75 per cent of the shares and voting rights.

The business remained dormant throughout its existence. It prepared accounts on that basis through its final accounting period and never developed an operating activity. Voluntary strike-off proceedings followed, and the company was dissolved in January 2026. The brief corporate history leaves Gulseven's wider business career and investment activity largely private.
